scope: 300 completed B and R trials in the published viewer. Excludes failed attempts.
method: Exact frozen input and tool-result text before final submission. Tool results are matched by call ID. Initial user messages are checked directly. Evidence message positions are one-based in the stored observable transcript.
interpretation: Returned content is evidence of exposure. The audit does not measure attention or whether the model used the wording.
